body:
Founder real-time: "add double kills to SHANKPIT and then make the bot
double kill aware in terms of rewards (spike)" / same for triple / same for
killtacular(4), with explicit tuning direction (healthy double, triple in
the middle, way more for killtacular).

Real, standard Halo-style rolling-window multikill tracking added to
PlayerState (kill_streak/last_kill_time_ms), updated in the one real place
every kill funnels through (phys_enter_death_state). Escalating bonus
added directly to accumulated_reward: double=+75, triple=+250,
killtacular=+1000 -- verified live as 1.5x/2.67x/7.66x a single kill's own
final reward magnitude. Reaches the bot automatically through the existing
reward_feedback tier, no separate reward-function code needed (documented
explicitly so this isn't a silent design decision).

Wire protocol grew 68->72 bytes (kill_streak added to NetPlayer),
re-verified via a compiled sizeof/offsetof probe. Full go test ./... and
python -m unittest green, live 2-bot UDP test with no panics. Live server +
bot pool redeployed.

Commit: SHANKPIT@9e17718.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-52: real multikill mechanic -- double/triple/killtacular, reward-aware
